title: Check how frozen context cutoffs transfer across three independent Latin authors
statement: Apply the existing seed and charter cutoffs to 25 source-bounded Latin works and excerpts. The internal same-morphology arm has adequate support for Seneca De Beneficiis (95 pairs), Cicero Ad Atticum (91), and Tacitus Annales I–III (89). The other 22 works abstain on this arm. Unequal right contexts occur in 73, 63, and 79 of those pairs, respectively. Both role-conditioned scores rank the planted us sign ahead of its paired um alternative on all three works. Only Seneca clears both frozen absolute cutoffs. None of the three alternatives clears either positional cutoff. With complete Case and Number on both members only Tacitus still reaches 40 pairs (43, against 37 in Seneca and 33 in Cicero). The three terminal same-stem controls tie and accept both candidates under both position-conditioned scores. The unplanted single-letter checks accept 21/30 under unconditioned scoring, 18/30 under position_all and 9/30 under position_info across the three works. Source-word and morphology checks cover 190 Seneca sites and independent samples of 6 Cicero and 10 Tacitus sites. The archive tolerance resolves a floating-point exact-equality assertion in one both-sides control, with maximum discrepancy 5.55e-17. The scores describe observable contexts of known planted strings.
check: Recreate the corpus versions and work boundaries from the provenance hashes and apply seed 66103 without refitting the charter thresholds. Independently verify the context and feature fields for the matched source IDs. Validate new independent works with fully populated and comparable inflectional features, and assess discrimination separately from cutoff acceptance. Continue using terminal and both-sides-matched controls to expose ties. Keep graphical identification based on the scan and test these results only as context evidence.

protocol:
# P-L1-025, independent Latin morphology controls

Evaluate every provenance-backed author/work file supplied by the fixed
treebank releases. Keep individual titles as separate works even if their
source annotation is split across train/dev/test. Do not pool authors,
different titles, or samples of unknown source. Retain disjoint provided
source excerpts of the same named work, and disclose partial coverage.
Screen only eligible pair counts before scoring. Record below-floor works
as abstentions without making their values comparable to supported works.

Use the archived P-L1-018 charter_context implementation, normalized
orthographic surface tokens, and fixed seed 66103 once per work. Planted X
replaces a genuine adjacent us pair and Z a matched um alternative. Test
internal_same_morph as primary, internal (without extra morphology) as
diagnostic, and terminal_same_stem_case and both_sides_matched as controls.
Match exact before-glyph, beginning/final location, UPOS, Case, and Number
as specified by the archived modes. One match per orthographic surface
token. Candidate/component minimum 40 and used positional reference
minimum 20. Keep all missing morphological values exactly as in the
archived primary matcher. Separately quantify support when UPOS, Case
and Number are all present, without selecting on that result.

Frozen charter cutoffs use the minimum of the ten common supported
development-decoy losses, not a population specificity percentile.
An acceptance requires score < cutoff - 1e-12. Run the original ten
unmodified natural-letter negative controls once per work. Record
score support, the direction of each paired comparison, absolute
acceptance of X and Z, ties, and abstentions. For contexts, independently
trace the first and last pair plus three equally spaced intervening
pairs in the seeded list to the originating source sentence/word and
verify exact matched features from the CoNLL-U rows. Keep aggregate
results, bounded examples and provenance, not the source treebank text.

Results describe transfer to these annotated surface forms. No Voynich
glyphs or manuscript splits are used.

Numerical assertion amendment after the attempted replay: in CIRCSE
Oedipus, 261 both-sides pairs produce float differences of 2.78e-17 and
5.55e-17 in two JS sums due to summation order. Permit the archived
1e-12 score tie tolerance in that structural assertion. Context data,
pairing, floating-point scores, cutoff decisions and the scoring rule
remain the same. The exact failed equality case is recorded.

cicero.range_checked: All matched pair coverage categories; one repeated verified sample per category

seneca.check: Independent extraction of archived token rows for every frozen matching site. Verify raw normalized surface, lemma, UPOS, Case, Number and immediate letters on both sides of the marked internal bigram, without altering the match or computing any scores.

prepare-lasla.py.source:
"""Strip extension columns and preserve independent LASLA work boundaries."""
import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

from latin_corpus import _surface_tokens

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
COMMIT = "c2e2bb6500b5ef9c6f5f31df6774423e9bb9fddc"
LASLA = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/CIRCSE/LASLA/" + COMMIT + "/conllup/"
WORKS = {
    "lasla-cicero-de-officiis": ("Cicero", "De officiis", "Books I–III",
        ("Cicero_DeOfficiis_CicOffic1.conllup", "Cicero_DeOfficiis_CicOffic2.conllup",
         "Cicero_DeOfficiis_CicOffic3.conllup")),
    "lasla-sallust-jugurtha": ("Sallust", "Bellum Iugurthinum", "Complete release file",
        ("Sallustius_Jugurtha_SalJugur.conllup",)),
    "lasla-tacitus-annales": ("Tacitus", "Annales", "Books I–III only",
        ("Tacitus_TacAnnales_TacAnn01.conllup", "Tacitus_TacAnnales_TacAnn02.conllup",
         "Tacitus_TacAnnales_TacAnn03.conllup")),
}


def convert(path):
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    part = []
    omitted = []
    blocks = re.split(r"\n\s*\n", raw.decode("utf-8-sig"))
    for index, block in enumerate(blocks, 1):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        rows = [line.split("\t")[:10] for line in lines if line and not line.startswith("#")]
        if not rows:
            continue
        headers = [line for line in lines if line.startswith("#")
                   and not line.startswith(("# global.columns", "# newdoc"))]
        id_line = next((line for line in headers if line.startswith("# sent_id = ")), None)
        if not id_line:
            omitted.append({"sentence_ordinal": index, "reason": "no source sentence ID"})
            continue
        sent_id = id_line.removeprefix("# sent_id = ")
        try:
            assert all(len(row) == 10 for row in rows)
            lines10 = ['\t'.join(r) for r in rows]
            _surface_tokens(lines10, sent_id)
        except (ValueError, AssertionError, KeyError) as e:
            omitted.append({"sentence_ordinal": index, "id": sent_id, "reason": str(e)})
            continue
        if not part:
            headers.insert(0, "# newdoc id = " + path.stem)
        part.append("\n".join(headers + lines10))
    detail = {"url": LASLA + path.name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),
              "included_sentences": len(part), "excluded_sentences": omitted}
    return part, detail


def main():
    provenance = {}
    for key, (author, title, coverage, names) in WORKS.items():
        blocks = []
        files = []
        for name in names:
            converted, details = convert(ROOT / "lasla-core" / name)
            blocks.extend(converted)
            files.append(details)
        out = ROOT / "corpus" / (key + ".conllu")
        out.write_text("\n\n".join(blocks) + "\n\n")
        provenance[key] = {"author": author, "title": title, "coverage": coverage,
                           "license": "CC BY-NC-SA 4.0", "raw": files,
                           "work_file_sha256": hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    (ROOT / "lasla-core-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(provenance, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Apply the archived matcher/scorer to separated new Latin works."""
from collections import Counter
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

import charter_context as core
from latin_corpus import iter_sentences

WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
SEED = 66103
MODES = ("internal_same_morph", "internal", "terminal_same_stem_case", "both_sides_matched")
THRESHOLDS = json.loads((WORK / "thresholds.json").read_text())


def read_work(file):
    words = []
    anchors = {}
    documents = Counter()
    surface = 0
    for sentence in iter_sentences(file, split=file.stem):
        documents[str(sentence.doc_id)] += 1
        for token in sentence.tokens:
            surface += 1
            m = token.morphology
            lemma = (m.lemma_ascii or "") if m else ""
            if " " in lemma:
                lemma = ""
            fields = tuple(getattr(m, k) or "" if m else ""
                           for k in ("upos", "case", "number", "gender"))
            for part in token.ascii_parts:
                w = core.Word(len(words), surface, part, lemma, *fields)
                words.append(w)
                anchors[w.index] = (sentence.sent_id, sentence.span, token)
    assert words
    return words, anchors, {
        "sha256": core.sha(file),
        "sentences": sum(documents.values()),
        "words": len(words),
        "documents": dict(sorted(documents.items())),
    }


def support(words, mode):
    sites = core.all_sites(words, "us", "um")
    pairs, counts = core.make_pairs(sites, mode, SEED, frozenset())
    profiles = Counter((x.word.upos, x.word.case, x.word.number) for x, _ in pairs)
    complete = sum(bool(x.word.upos and x.word.case and x.word.number) for x, _ in pairs)
    strict = [(decoy, x) for decoy, x in sites if x.word.upos and x.word.case and x.word.number]
    strict_pairs = core.make_pairs(strict, mode, SEED, frozenset())[0]
    counts.update({
        "pairs": len(pairs),
        "right_context_mismatches": sum(x.after != z.after for x, z in pairs),
        "pairs_with_complete_pos_case_number": complete,
        "support_if_require_complete_features": len(strict_pairs),
        "largest_profile": max(profiles.values(), default=0),
        "target_lemmas": len({x.word.lemma for x, _ in pairs if x.word.lemma}),
        "decoy_lemmas": len({z.word.lemma for _, z in pairs if z.word.lemma}),
    })
    return sites, pairs, counts


def trace_pairs(pairs, anchors):
    if not pairs:
        return []
    result = []
    for i in sorted({q * (len(pairs) - 1) // 4 for q in range(5)}):
        record = []
        for j, site in enumerate(pairs[i]):
            sentence, span, token = anchors[site.word.index]
            shape = ("us", "um")[j]
            assert site.word.form in token.ascii_parts
            assert site.word.form[site.onset:site.onset + 2] == shape
            assert site.before == (site.word.form[site.onset - 1] if site.onset else " ")
            assert site.after == (site.word.form[site.onset + 2] if site.onset + 2 < len(site.word.form) else " ")
            morphology = token.morphology
            actual = [getattr(morphology, k) or "" if morphology else "" for k in ("upos", "case", "number")]
            assert actual == [site.word.upos, site.word.case, site.word.number]
            record.append({"sent_id": sentence, "source_span": span, "source_token_id": token.id,
                           "surface_index": site.word.surface_index,
                           "onset": site.onset, "pair": shape, "preceding": site.before, "following": site.after,
                           "upos_case_number": actual})
        result.append(record)
    return result


def main():
    scoring = "--score" in sys.argv
    result = {}
    files = sorted((WORK / "corpus").glob("*.conllu"))
    assert files
    for file in files:
        words, anchors, data = read_work(file)
        sites, pairs, primary = support(words, "internal_same_morph")
        row = {"source": data, "primary_support": primary}
        if scoring:
            entries = [core.assess(words, sites, "us", "um", mode, SEED, frozenset()) for mode in MODES]
            negatives = core.negative_controls(words, THRESHOLDS)
            row.update({
                "comparisons": entries,
                "summaries": core.summarized(entries, THRESHOLDS),
                "negatives": negatives,
                "trace": trace_pairs(pairs, anchors),
                "negative_counts": {
                    method: {
                        "accepted": sum(x["acceptances"][method] for x in negatives),
                        "supported": sum(x["scores"][method] is not None for x in negatives),
                    } for method in core.METHODS
                },
            })
        result[file.stem] = row
        print(file.stem, data["words"], primary["pairs"], primary["pairs_with_complete_pos_case_number"], flush=True)
    resultfile = WORK / ("scored.json" if scoring else "support.json")
    resultfile.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""Trace the preregistered Tacitus sample to unmodified archival rows."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import re

from latin_corpus import normalize_latin

work = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
traces = json.loads((work / "scored.json").read_text())["lasla-tacitus-annales"]["trace"]
archive = {}
for path in sorted((work / "lasla-core").glob("Tacitus_*.conllup")):
    for block in re.split(r"\n\s*\n", path.read_text()):
        lines = block.splitlines()
        key = next((line.removeprefix("# sent_id = ") for line in lines
                    if line.startswith("# sent_id = ")), None)
        if key:
            assert key not in archive
            archive[key] = (path.name, {x.split("\t")[0]: x.split("\t") for x in lines
                                        if x and not x.startswith("#")})
checked = []
for pair in traces:
    for site in pair:
        name, rows = archive[site["sent_id"]]
        values = rows[site["source_token_id"]]
        form = normalize_latin(values[1])
        i = site["onset"]
        expected = [(form[i-1] if i else " "), form[i:i+2], (form[i+2] if i+2<len(form) else " ")]
        assert expected == [site["preceding"], site["pair"], site["following"]]
        features = dict(kv.split("=",1) for kv in values[5].split("|") if "=" in kv)
        assert [values[3],features.get("Case",""),features.get("Number","")] == site["upos_case_number"]
        hierarchy = re.search(r"CitationHierarchy=([^|]+)", values[9])
        checked.append(site | {"raw_work_file": name, "citation_hierarchy": hierarchy[1] if hierarchy else None})
(work / "tacitus-spotcheck.json").write_text(json.dumps(checked,indent=2,ensure_ascii=False)+"\n")
print(f"Matched {len(checked)} traced sites directly to the source token and quoted only feature/context identifiers.")

}
MAPPINGS = {"proiel": PROIEL, "circse": CIRCSE, "perseus": PERSEUS}


def digest(content):
    return hashlib.sha256(content).hexdigest()


def metadata(block, key):
    found = re.search(rf"(?m)^# {re.escape(key)} = (.+)$", block)
    return found[1].strip() if found else None


def block_order(row, repo):
    index, sent, source, _ = row
    if repo == "circse":
        return int(sent.rsplit("-", 1)[-1]), index
    if repo == "perseus":
        return int(sent.rsplit("@", 1)[-1]), index
    m = re.search(r"[0-9]+(?:\.[0-9]+)*$", source or "")
    if m:
        return tuple(map(int, m[0].split("."))), index
    # Per-release file ordering is retained within each source passage and
    # unobtrusively preserved for Palladius' Roman chapter headings.
    return (), index


def screen():
    output_dir = ROOT / "corpus"
    output_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    provenance = {}
    for repo, (ud_name, commit, license_name) in REPOS.items():
        source_dir = ROOT / "corpora-candidates" / repo
        mapping = MAPPINGS[repo]
        input_records, groups = {}, defaultdict(list)
        for order, split in enumerate(("train", "dev", "test")):
            path = source_dir / f"la_{repo}-ud-{split}.conllu"
            if not path.exists():
                if repo == "perseus" and split == "dev":
                    continue
                raise FileNotFoundError(path)
            original = path.read_bytes()
            input_records[split] = {
                "file": str(path.relative_to(ROOT)),
                "url": f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_Latin-{ud_name}/{commit}/{path.name}",
                "sha256": digest(original),
                "bytes": len(original),
            }
            for i, block in enumerate(original.decode("utf-8").strip().split("\n\n")):
                sent = metadata(block, "sent_id")
                if not sent:
                    raise ValueError(f"missing sent_id in {repo}/{split}/{i}")
                source = metadata(block, "source") if repo == "proiel" else sent
                if not source:
                    raise ValueError(f"missing # source in {repo}/{split}/{i}")
                prefix = next((prefix for prefix in mapping if source.startswith(prefix)), None)
                if prefix:
                    groups[prefix].append(((order, i), sent, source, block))
        assert set(groups) == set(mapping), (repo, set(mapping) - set(groups))
        works = {}
        for prefix, rows in groups.items():
            slug, author, title, genre = mapping[prefix]
            ordered = sorted(rows, key=lambda row: block_order(row, repo))
            assert len({row[1] for row in ordered}) == len(ordered), (repo, slug)
            body = ("\n\n".join(row[3] for row in ordered) + "\n\n").encode()
            out = output_dir / f"{repo}-{slug}.conllu"
            out.write_bytes(body)
            occurrences, sites, _ = _build_input(out)
            pairs, info = make_pairs(sites, "internal_same_morph", 66103, frozenset())
            terminal, term_support = make_pairs(sites, "terminal_same_stem_case", 66103, frozenset())
            sentences = sum(1 for _ in iter_sentences(out, split="test"))
            works[f"{repo}-{slug}"] = {
                "author": author, "title": title, "genre": genre, "source_prefix": prefix,
                "file": str(out.relative_to(ROOT)), "sha256": digest(body), "sentences": sentences,
                "split_sentence_counts": dict(Counter(("train", "dev", "test")[row[0][0]] for row in rows)),
                "source_sections": list(dict.fromkeys(row[2] for row in ordered)) if repo == "proiel" else None,
                "sent_id_first": ordered[0][1], "sent_id_last": ordered[-1][1],
                "matcher_seed": 66103, "source_sites": len(occurrences),
                "internal_same_morph_pairs": len(pairs), "internal_support_details": info,
                "internal_right_context_disagreements": sum(a.after != b.after for a, b in pairs),
                "terminal_same_stem_case_pairs": len(terminal),
                "terminal_support_details": term_support,
            }
            print(repo, slug, sentences, len(pairs), len(terminal), flush=True)
        license_path = source_dir / "LICENSE.txt"
        provenance[repo] = {
            "source": f"https://github.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_Latin-{ud_name}/tree/{commit}",
            "commit": commit, "license": license_name,
            "license_url": f"https://raw.githubusercontent.com/UniversalDependencies/UD_Latin-{ud_name}/{commit}/LICENSE.txt",
            "license_sha256": digest(license_path.read_bytes()),
            "raw_splits": input_records, "works": works,
        }
    (ROOT / "corpus-candidate-provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(provenance, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2) + "\n")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    screen()
